name: Haus Montjola
beschreibung: The Haus Montjola occupies an elevated, sunny hillside location in Sölden within the Tyrolean Ötztal, boasting expansive panoramic views across the valley floor and glaciated alpine summits. The welcoming guest rooms and holiday flats are styled in classic alpine woodwork, equipped with modern bathrooms, satellite TV, and scenic balconies. Guests can look forward to a hearty breakfast buffet filled with regional produce each morning. The peaceful setting above the village guarantees restful nights while keeping the town centre and major cable cars within effortless reach. In winter, the ski bus stops nearby, whisking visitors up to Sölden's world-class slopes, while summer invites hiking and biking enthusiasts directly into the mountains.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse in a peaceful panoramic location in Sölden in the Ötztal with comfortable rooms and glacier views.
